name: omits exitCode
body: kiana.on("user_bash", () => ({ result: { output: "x", cancelled: false, truncated: false } }));

name: has a null exitCode
body: kiana.on("user_bash", () => ({ result: { output: "x", exitCode: null, cancelled: false, truncated: false } }));

name: has both operations and result
body: kiana.on("user_bash", () => ({ operations: { exec: async () => ({ exitCode: 0 }) }, result: { output: "x", exitCode: 0, cancelled: false, truncated: false } }));
